qs.q: At which level of the health system and for what specific function are deep freezers utilized?
o: Regional, store up to three months
District and PHC, only for ice packs
qs.e: Deep freezers operate at -15oc to -25oc at district and primary health care levels, where they are used only for preparing ice packs. They are not the primary storage units for most standard vaccines at the PHC.
